name: 32063 · Macclenny, FL
findings: ZIP 32063 (Macclenny) has 28 nonprofit organizations. 3 of them (11%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 2 organizations.
33% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
